responsibility: Supplies rs6000 target-hook overrides needed for PowerPC 476 support outside the generic backend. In particular it redirects the link-stack policy and end-of-assembly hook to rs6000 helpers, tying the 476-specific option state into final assembly emission so code generation can preserve the processor’s link stack behavior when requested.
same_name_distinction: Header-only companion to 476.md and 476.opt: it does not describe scheduling or declare options, but wires the 476 option state into target macros and hooks by overriding TARGET_LINK_STACK, SET_TARGET_LINK_STACK, and TARGET_ASM_CODE_END.
